name: The Ballad Singer
source:
The Ballad Singer is an RPG/Visual Novel, set in a fantasy world which is completely governed by the player's choices.

We've taken elements from game-books and visual novels to develop a videogame with an unprecedented format. TBS offers a fantasy story yet to be written, where the world changes and reacts to the player's actions. This will allow you to live up to 1700 stories and 40 different endings, your decisions will affect the way the tale unfolds. Every single development and subplot in your story will be completely narrated and illustrated, even the smallest ones. Death is final, you won't be able to go back to try and correct your mistakes. In TBS, every choice is crucial.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/curtelgames/the-ballad-singer-write-your-own-fantasy-story/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《歌谣歌手》是一款角色扮演游戏/视觉小说，背景设定在一个完全由玩家选择控制的奇幻世界中。

我们从游戏书籍和视觉小说中汲取元素，开发了一款前所未有的视频游戏。TBS提供了一个尚未编写的奇幻故事，其中世界会发生变化并对玩家的行为做出反应。这将让你经历多达1700个故事和40个不同的结局，你的决定将影响故事的展开方式。故事中的每一个发展和次要情节都将被完整地叙述和说明，即使是最小的。死亡是最终的结局，你将无法回去尝试纠正你的错误。在TBS中，每一个选择都至关重要。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/curtelgames/the-ballad-singer-write-your-own-fantasy-story/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
